analysis.reasonEn: Previous 3 sessions held a buy recommendation, but today RSI dropped to 31.1 entering oversold territory. MACD histogram worsened from 202.5819 to -95.4706, forming a death cross. While a 'Higher Low' pattern emerged with the 5-day low exceeding the 20-day low, a 'Lower High' pattern also appeared with the 5-day high falling below the 20-day high, indicating a lack of clear direction. Volume increased by 1.34x the 5-day average, but due to deteriorating indicators, entry is postponed.
